leadText:
Super Wallets are a type of DVD package that were released by (now known as Beyond Home Entertainment) for . Magna Pacific began releasing Pokémon Super Wallets to celebrate the Pokémon 10th Anniversary.

Super Wallets were released for seasons 1 to 9 of , with each season having discs designed to resemble a certain Poké Ball. Some Super Wallets also included a bonus disc (which was designed to resemble a Premier Ball), containing either episodes of Pokémon Chronicles or The Mastermind of Mirage Pokémon. These sets include a collectors' disc wallet containing the discs, as well as a booklet with descriptions of the episodes.

In Region 4 releases, the episodes are ordered and separated according to standard seasons (in the same way as on Pokémon.com), rather than by Viz Media season (as seen in Region 1 releases). The DVDs do not include English closed captioning.

==Trivia==
The last four episodes of Pokémon: Indigo League (The Case of the K-9 Caper!, Pokémon Paparazzi, The Ultimate Test, The Breeding Center Secret) are not included in this release. They were not released on Region 4 home video until the on March 10, 2010.
